passages.sermon: David wrote this psalm.\r\nThe choirmaster should lead this psalm.\r\n

passages.text: In the LORD I take refuge. How then can you say to me: “Flee like a bird to your mountain!
passages.sermon:
David wrote this psalm.
David speaks to the choirmaster.
David says, “I take refuge in the LORD.”
David asks, “How can you tell me to flee?”
David says, “Do not tell me to run away like a bird to the mountain.”
passages.original: לַמְנַצֵּ֗חַ לְדָ֫וִ֥ד בַּֽיהוָ֨ה׀ חָסִ֗יתִי אֵ֭יךְ תֹּאמְר֣וּ לְנַפְשִׁ֑י נוּדוּ הַרְכֶ֥ם צִפּֽוֹר׃

passages.text: For behold, the wicked bend their bows. They set their arrow on the string to shoot from the shadows at the upright in heart.
passages.sermon:
The wicked are people who do evil.
The wicked bend their bows.
They prepare their arrows.
They place their arrows on the string.
They want to shoot their arrows.
They hide in the shadows.
They aim at people who are upright in heart.
Upright people do what is right.
The wicked attack upright people from hidden places.
passages.original: כִּ֤י הִנֵּ֪ה הָרְשָׁעִ֡ים יִדְרְכ֬וּן קֶ֗שֶׁת כּוֹנְנ֣וּ חִצָּ֣ם עַל־ יֶ֑תֶר לִיר֥וֹת בְּמוֹ־ אֹ֝֗פֶל לְיִשְׁרֵי־ לֵֽב׃

passages.text: If the foundations are destroyed, what can the righteous do?”
passages.sermon: The foundations are destroyed.\r\nThe righteous person cannot act.\r\nThe righteous person cannot do anything.
passages.original: כִּ֣י הַ֭שָּׁתוֹת יֵֽהָרֵס֑וּן צַ֝דִּ֗יק מַה־ פָּעָֽל׃

passages.text: The LORD is in His holy temple; the LORD is on His heavenly throne. His eyes are watching closely; they examine the sons of men.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is present in His holy temple.
The LORD sits on His throne in heaven.
The LORD watches all people with His eyes.
The LORD examines every person carefully.
passages.original: יְהוָ֤ה׀ בְּֽהֵ֘יכַ֤ל קָדְשׁ֗וֹ יְהוָה֮ בַּשָּׁמַ֪יִם כִּ֫סְא֥וֹ עֵינָ֥יו יֶחֱז֑וּ עַפְעַפָּ֥יו יִ֝בְחֲנ֗וּ בְּנֵ֣י אָדָֽם׃

passages.text: The LORD tests the righteous and the wicked; His soul hates the lover of violence.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is righteous.
The LORD tests the righteous.
The LORD also tests the wicked.
The LORD hates those who love violence.
His soul rejects the lover of violence.
passages.original: יְהוָה֮ צַדִּ֪יק יִ֫בְחָ֥ן וְ֭רָשָׁע וְאֹהֵ֣ב חָמָ֑ס שָֽׂנְאָ֥ה נַפְשֽׁוֹ׃

passages.text: On the wicked He will rain down fiery coals and sulfur; a scorching wind will be their portion.
passages.sermon:
The LORD punishes the wicked.
He sends traps on them.
He rains down fire on them.
He sends burning sulfur on them.
He gives them a scorching wind as their share.
passages.original: יַמְטֵ֥ר עַל־ רְשָׁעִ֗ים פַּ֫חִ֥ים אֵ֣שׁ וְ֭גָפְרִית וְר֥וּחַ זִלְעָפ֗וֹת מְנָ֣ת כּוֹסָֽם׃

passages.text: For the LORD is righteous; He loves justice. The upright will see His face.
passages.sermon: The LORD is righteous.\r\nHe loves justice.\r\nUpright people will see His face.
passages.original: כִּֽי־ צַדִּ֣יק יְ֭הוָה צְדָק֣וֹת אָהֵ֑ב יָ֝שָׁ֗ר יֶחֱז֥וּ פָנֵֽימוֹ׃
